jinxes.reason: If the Cannibal gains the Butler ability, the Cannibal learns this.
If the Organ Grinder is causing eyes closed voting, the Butler may raise their hand to vote but their vote is only counted if their master voted too.
If the Juggler guesses on their first day and dies by execution, tonight the living Cannibal learns how many guesses the Juggler got correct.
If the Cannibal gains the Zealot ability, the Cannibal learns this.
The Chambermaid learns if the Mathematician wakes tonight or not, even though the Chambermaid wakes first.
The Mathematician learns if the Lunatic attacks a different player(s) than the real Demon attacked.
If the Spy is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
If the Widow is (or has been) in play, the Damsel is poisoned.
The Marionette does not learn that a Damsel is in play.
If a Pit-Hag creates a Damsel, the Storyteller chooses which player it is.
The Baron might only add 1 Outsider, not 2.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
Only 1 jinxed character can be in play.
A Pit-Hag can not create a Heretic.
If the Lleech has poisoned the Heretic, and the Lleech dies, the Heretic remains poisoned.
If the Pit-Hag turns an evil player into the Cult Leader, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Balloonist, +1 Outsider might have been added.
When the Poppy Grower dies, the Demon learns the Marionette but the Marionette learns nothing.
The Marionette does not learn 3 not in-play characters. The Demon learns an extra 3 instead.
If the Marionette thinks that they are the Huntsman, the Damsel was added.
The Marionette neighbors a Minion, not the Demon. The Marionette is not woken to choose who takes the Lil' Monsta token.
The Marionette neighbors the Summoner, not the Demon. The Summoner knows who the Marionette is.
Each night, the Magician chooses a Minion: if that Minion and Lil' Monsta are alive, that Minion babysits Lil' Monsta.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, Minions don't wake together. They are woken one by one, until one of them chooses to take the Lil' Monsta token.
If there are 5 or more players alive and the player holding the Lil' Monsta token dies, the Scarlet Woman is given the Lil' Monsta token tonight.
When the Spy sees the Grimoire, the Demon's and Magician's character tokens are removed.
When the Widow sees the Grimoire, the Demon's and Magician's character tokens are removed.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, the Spy does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.
If the Poppy Grower is in play, the Widow does not see the Grimoire until the Poppy Grower dies.
The Cerenovus may choose to make a player mad that they are the Goblin, instead of a good character.
If the Philosopher gains the Bounty Hunter ability, a Townsfolk might turn evil.
If the Lycanthrope is alive and the Gambler kills themself at night, no one else can die that night.
If the Fang Gu chooses an Outsider and dies, the Scarlet Woman does not become the Fang Gu.
If there are two living Al-Hadikhias, the Scarlet Woman Al-Hadikhia becomes the Scarlet Woman again.
If the Slayer slays the Lleech's host, the host dies.
If the Vortox kills the Banshee, all players still learn that the Banshee has died.
If Leviathan is in play and no execution occurs on day 5, good wins.
If Leviathan is in play and the Ravenkeeper dies by execution, they wake that night to use their ability.
If Leviathan is in play and the Sage dies by execution, they wake that night to use their ability.
If Leviathan is in play and a Farmer dies by execution, a good player becomes a Farmer that night.
If Riot nominates and kills the Saint, the good team loses.
If Riot kills the Farmer, a good player becomes a Farmer tonight.
If Riot kills the Ravenkeeper, the Ravenkeeper wakes that night to use their ability.
If Riot kills the Sage, the Sage wakes that night to use their ability.
If Riot kills the Grandchild, the Grandmother dies too.
The Alchemist can not have the Summoner ability.
If the Summoner is poisoned on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon, but the Storyteller chooses which player becomes that Demon.
If the Summoner is drunk on the 3rd night, the Summoner chooses which Demon, but the Storyteller chooses which player becomes that Demon.
An evil Townsfolk is only created if the Kazali chooses the Bounty Hunter.
The Kazali can not choose the King to become a Minion.
If the Kazali chooses to create a Marionette, they must choose one of their alive neighbors to be it.
If the Storyteller gains the Baron ability, up to 2 Townsfolk players become not-in-play Outsiders.
If the Demon dies while the Storyteller has the Scarlet Woman ability, a living Minion becomes the Demon.
The Boffin can not give the Demon the Heretic ability.
If the Demon has the Cult Leader ability, they can't turn good due to their own ability.
If the Boffin gives the Demon the Drunk ability, the Demon thinks they have been given a different not-in-play Townsfolk ability.
If the Exorcist chooses the Yaggababble, the Yaggababble does not kill due to their public phrase that night.
